summary: First E2E test iteration for Walterstown GFC Pitch Booking. Backend: created pytest suite (21 tests) covering public facilities/settings/availability, guest free & paid bookings (Stripe checkout_url produced), repeat bookings, full-vs-parts conflict logic, lookup, JWT cookie auth (register/login/me/my-bookings), and full admin surface (requests filter/approve/decline, facility CRUD, blocks CRUD w/ availability propagation, settings). All 21 tests pass (100%). Frontend: verified homepage (6 facility cards with FREE/PAID badges + photos), Astro booking wizard (4 part pills, availability timeline, correct per-session pricing €60 full / €21 cage), status tracker resolves WGFC-1000 to approved, admin login works and all 4 tabs load with expected data-testid elements (edit-facility x6, block-* fields, settings-* fields, filter-* pills, approve/decline buttons per request). No console errors.

issues: Uses native HTML date input (<input type=date>) rather than shadcn calendar component. Acceptable but not consistent with rest of shadcn UI.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `BookingCreate.duration_minutes` uses Pydantic `le=600`, but club max default is 270. Server correctly re-validates against settings and returns 400 — good, no bug.
server.py `/api/settings/public`: assumes settings doc exists (uses `s.get(...)`); seed creates it on startup so fine, but a missing doc would 500. Consider `s = s or {}`.
auth.py: cookies use `samesite='none'; secure=True` — correct for cross-site preview domain.
server.py: CORS `allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, localhost:3000]` with `allow_credentials=True` — good (no wildcard with credentials).
seed_admin correctly updates password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (idempotent).
Stripe integration successfully produces valid checkout.stripe.com URLs on the sandbox key; payment_transactions row is created with status=initiated as expected.
Bcrypt hashes verified via successful login flow (format $2b$).
Brute-force lockout implemented (5 attempts / 15 min lock).
seed_data_creation: Tests created multiple TEST_-prefixed bookings (WGFC-2004..2010). Sample seeds WGFC-1000..1003 remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — safe to re-run. If it detects excessive TEST_ bookings, clean db.requests where booker_name LIKE 'TEST_%'. All test-ids from problem statement verified present in DOM.
